steps.en: Keep a supported WeChat build (up to 3.7.0) in Applications and stop it updating
steps.zh: 在“应用程序”里留一个受支持的微信版本（最高 3.7.0），别让它更新

steps.en: Clone the repo and run its install script in Terminal
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，在终端里跑安装脚本

steps.en: Backs up WeChat's executable, copies in its framework and patches the binary to load it
steps.zh: 备份微信可执行文件，拷入插件 framework，改写二进制让它启动时加载

steps.en: Restart WeChat and switch features on from the 微信小助手 menu
steps.zh: 重启微信，在菜单栏“微信小助手”里打开功能

steps.en: Swaps WeChat's own methods for its versions, so revoked messages stay and keyword replies go out
steps.zh: 把微信自己的方法换成它的版本：撤回的消息留下，命中关键字就自动回复

value.en: Anti-revoke, auto-reply and multi-instance inside the official client — until the next WeChat update
value.zh: 在官方客户端里就有防撤回、自动回复和多开——直到微信下一次更新

sources: README.md @ master (113b9a0, 2023-03-21) 功能 ('支持微信 3.7.0', '新增禁止微信检测更新开关(非App Store版本)'); 使用 (消息防撤回 command + t; 自动回复 conmand + k [sic]); 安装 (git clone ... && ./WeChatPlugin-MacOS/Other/Install.sh; 重启微信，在菜单栏中看到微信小助手); 依赖 (insert_dylib, fishhook, GCDWebServer)
Other/Install.sh @ master (wechat_path=/Applications/WeChat.app; cp WeChat WeChat_backup; cp -r WeChatPlugin.framework into Contents/MacOS; insert_dylib --all-yes)
WeChatPlugin/Sources/Hook/WeChat+hook.m @ master (tk_hookMethod swaps methods on WeChat classes such as FFProcessReqsvrZZ, AccountService, MMSessionMgr)
